desc:
CRISPY WAFFLE SHAPES: Crispy cereal piece shaped like mini waffles and blasted with irresistible cinnamon-sugar CINNADUST

REAL CINNAMON: This whole wheat and corn cereal delights taste buds with real cinnamon and a crispy crunch

EPIC ANY TIME: Pair with milk and slurp the CINNAMILK cereal milk at the bottom of the bowl as part of an easy breakfast; Or enjoy by the handful as a cinnamony snack

WHOLE GRAIN: Each serving has 14g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), is a good source of calcium, and contains 12 vitamins and minerals

CONTAINS: One 11.6 oz box of Cinnamon Toast Crunch Waffle Cereal
features:
Key Features:

Waffle-Shaped Cereal Pieces

Fun mini waffle shapes coated in the classic Cinnamon Toast Crunch cinnamon-sugar blend ("Cinnadust").

Real Cinnamon Flavor

Made with real cinnamon to deliver the iconic, sweet-spicy flavor fans love.

Whole Grain Goodness

Includes 14 grams of whole grain per serving, supporting a more balanced start to your day.

Fortified with Vitamins and Minerals

Provides essential nutrients including calcium and vitamin D.

Multi-Purpose Snacking

Great in a bowl with milk, enjoyed dry as a crunchy snack, or added to snack mixes.

Benefits:

Delicious and Nostalgic

Captures the beloved flavor of Cinnamon Toast Crunch with a fun twist in shape and texture.

Kid-Friendly and Fun

Waffle design makes breakfast playful and exciting, especially for children.

Convenient and Versatile

Works as a breakfast cereal or an anytime snack—easy to pack and eat on the go.

Lightly Sweetened

Offers sweetness without being overwhelming; contains 10g of added sugars per serving.
ingredients: Whole Grain Wheat, Corn Meal, Sugar, Fructose, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Cinnamon, Salt, Soy Lecithin, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor, Rosemary Extract. BHT Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3
